name: Tri
description: The spitter, drawn alone in the same wool as Dot but on no frame of Dot's: the belly changed all of it. Tri let the hive's work be done on it so it could throw acid, and the body is the price. The belly is swollen into a sac wider than the chest, the wool tunic stretched over it and creased where it pulls, with a stitched seam running down the front where it was opened and closed. Everything above the hips is thrown back to balance it, the legs under it are short and thick in loose wool trousers, and the arms hang out from the sides because they cannot hang straight. Nothing is worn that would get in the way of a body like this: the head, the hands and the feet are bare, the only leather a binding on the tunic's hem, and the only thing carried is the dead organ on its cord above the belly. The head is `ss.lib.tri-head` composed at a quarter of its size, larger than Dot's on the body, tilted back with the chin up: a bare stitched skull, the face whole, the mouth uncovered and stained at the corner where the acid comes out, a throat swollen into a gland under the jaw. No feelers — those are Dot's weapon. It stands back on its heels and breathes with the belly, and it walks in a slow lurch. Drawn facing +x; the game flips it.

idle.description: thrown back on the heels with the belly forward: the sac does the breathing, a slow swell that lifts the whole front; the chest rocks a hair behind it, the head lifts on the in-breath, and the arms, held out from the belly because they cannot hang straight, drift out and back

walk.description: a slow lurch: short steps on the short thick legs, bare feet slapping down with a heavy drop as each lands, the upper body rolling forward and back over the hips a beat behind the feet and the belly a beat behind that, the head nodding with it, the arms swung wide and loose for balance
